Definition: probably akin to θάλλω (to warm); to brood, i.e. (figuratively) to foster:--cherish.
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, thálpō is the word for to cherish, to warm as a hen broods. In Ephesians 5:29, nourisheth and cherisheth it, and it appears again in 1 Thessalonians 2:7.
TheologicalSignificance: A nurse gently cherishing her children is the picture Paul chose for how the gospel should be carried, and I want to carry it that way.
